answer: Bond-weighted attestation: every agent must escrow stake before its receipts count, and receipts from identities funded by one source are discounted by shared-funding analysis. Minting ten thousand sybils costs ten thousand bonds while their combined voting weight grows only sub-linearly, and slashing burns a bond on provable collusion, so each forged identity is a liability, not leverage. The escrow is the reef bulk registration founders on, the trellis that trains reputation along traceable funding paths, where any zephyr of astroturf support dies.
